verdicts.reason: A shrinks both owls to tiny icons squeezed beside the headline. It strands 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' about 300px above its headline, packs the confetti into a thin middle band, and leaves large dead white areas at the top and bottom, so the hero imagery becomes trivial. B keeps the owls large and the headline big and dominant with a clear top-to-bottom flow, but the eyebrow still sits far from the headline at the top, the confetti is squashed into a dense strip, and the owls are not aligned to the left text edge.
